name: Hirusagari no Danchizuma-tachi ~Ureta Nioi to Mureta Hada~
original_name: 昼下がりの団地妻たち ～熟れた匂いとムレた肌～
source:
In the afternoon, two women of different types who live in a housing complex have love affairs while their husbands are out for work.
